data.one_liner: Background location tracking and geofencing for iOS and Android
data.what_it_does: Provides continuous background location updates and geofencing with motion‑detection to conserve battery. It exposes a simple API for configuring distance filters, event callbacks, and geofence management.
use_when: Need reliable background location updates on both iOS and Android
Require geofencing with automatic start/stop based on device motion
Want battery‑conscious tracking that pauses when stationary
avoid_when: Only need foreground location or simple one‑shot location requests
You cannot afford a paid license for release builds
strengths: Cross‑platform (iOS & Android) with a single API
Built‑in geofence management and event handling
weaknesses: Requires a paid license for release builds
Plugin size and native dependencies may increase app size
Setup requires platform‑specific permissions and configuration
data.setup_notes: Add Android permissions (ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION) and iOS plist entries (NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription, NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription). Include the license key in the AndroidManifest or iOS Info.plist. No build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides basic foreground/background location but no geofencing or motion detection

alternatives.name: location
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simple location API for both platforms but lacks geofencing and advanced background features
